day_shape: 78 items: IRGC claims six-drone strike on US radar at Al-Rifa base in Bahrain, IDF confirms killing of Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Samir Abu Younis, UKMTO reports tanker attack near Strait of Hormuz, heavy Fatimiyya mourning cycle from Khamenei's office, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: IRGC Bahrain drone-strike claim
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB said the IRGC launched six armed drones at a US air-defence radar at Al-Rifa helicopter base in Bahrain, describing it as a 'second phase' response. Jerusalem Post reported the IRGC announcement via Iranian state television.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incidents
threads.summary: IRIB cited UKMTO reporting an attack on a tanker moving eastward in the Persian Gulf before the Strait of Hormuz, and claimed five tankers had struck mines in 48 hours. CENTCOM posted that over 1.7 billion barrels have transited Hormuz under US protection.

threads.label: Killing of Hamas Rafah Brigade commander
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed the killing of Samir Abu Younis, commander of Hamas's Rafah Brigade, in an overnight strike in Khan Younis's Al-Mawasi area. Al-Qassam Brigades confirmed his death; Abu Younis had been appointed roughly two months earlier.

threads.label: Fatimiyya mourning cycle at Khamenei's office
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a sequence of videos and audio from the fifth and final night of Fatimiyya mourning ceremonies held in his presence on 23 Aban, including elegies by Mehdi Rosouli and Morteza Taheri. IRIB and Defa Press carried parallel coverage of the Zainabiyyah ceremonies.

threads.label: Iran missile stockpile and strike reach
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post cited US intelligence assessments putting Iran's remaining missile stockpile at 1,500–2,500, over half the pre-war estimate, and reported Israel's defence establishment sees no urgent justification to strike Iran while no government is formed. Iran International reported state TV naming RAF Fairford as reachable by a modified Khorramshahr missile.

threads.label: Iran fuel shortages and public unrest
threads.summary: Iran International reported petrol-sale restrictions triggering complaints from transport operators warning of price rises, and examined whether higher prices could curb smuggling. IRIB said Hormozgan residents' petrol ration will increase following the Deputy Executive's visit.

threads.label: Araghchi regional diplomacy
threads.summary: Iran's foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei announced Araghchi will travel to Islamabad for the 30th ECO foreign ministers' council on Monday and then to Muscat for talks with his Omani counterpart. IRIB also reported Araghchi met Afghanistan's Finance Minister Mohammad Nasser Akhund in Tehran.

events.title_en: Golali Babaei: the literature of the recent war should be narrated from the heart of the people in the field
events.summary_en: Golali Babaei: the literature of the recent war should be narrated from the heart of the people in the field. A writer and researcher of sacred defence literature, in conversation with Defapress, said: literature should be shaped from the heart of people's lived experience and narrators present in the field; cinema and television should also, by adapting these works, depict war. In the eight-year war perhaps people in border areas were more confronted with war, but today people in Tehran and most cities and villages of Iran also hear the sound of missiles and their explosions, see the destruction and observe the dismembered bodies of the martyrs. On this basis, I believe these events cause the literature of recent wars to take on a more popular colour than that of the eight-year defence.
